name: Traffic Prediction Benchmark (Dynamic Graph Convolutional Recurrent Network)
description: A benchmark and baseline solution for traffic forecasting that evaluates spatio-temporal graph-based prediction methods on traffic datasets.
evaluation_method: MAE, RMSE (mean absolute error and root mean squared error) — sometimes MAPE
notes: Non-LLM benchmark focused on spatio-temporal forecasting; results are dataset- and sensor-dependent. Common caveats: temporal non-stationarity, varying graph connectivity, and potential leakage if future information is used in preprocessing.
